title: Yellow Buttery Dutch Egg Rolls Spring Rolls
description: A romantic Dutch dish featuring egg rolls with a buttery and shaggy texture, made with render fat and ayurvedic sattvic friendly ingredients. This dish is perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the chopped scallions, grated carrots, and shredded cabbage.
Add the turmeric, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and mix well.
Layout an egg roll wrapper on a flat surface and place about 1 tablespoon of the vegetable mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Brush the edges of the wrapper with a little bit of water and fold the bottom half up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrapper to form a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
When the oil is hot, add a few of the egg rolls to the pan and fry until they are golden brown, about 3-4 minutes on each side.
Remove the egg rolls from the oil with a slotted spoon and place them on a paper towel lined plate to drain excess oil.
Melt the rendered fat and unsalted butter in a small saucepan over low heat.
Serve the egg rolls hot with the melted butter and fat spooned over the top.
